item.title: Looking for a condensed font with a large x-height
item.description:
Hello!

It’s my first time here, so I’ll quickly introduce myself: I’m Carel Fransen, graphic designer from the Netherlands, and currently working on my graduation projects.

For my project, I’m looking for a quality condensed font with a large x-height that does great at small corps-sizes (approx. 6-7 pt).

I have got one font that works very well: Bureau Grot Light. However, I’d like to have some options. Unfortunately, due to the “advanced search”-mechanisms on big font-sites not being that advanced, it’s nearly impossible to search for something this specific.

item.title: Old-looking, outlined font.
item.description:
I’ve been trying to look for this font for ages.
The first time I saw it was in a title card in an animated series, and I thought that it was custom made, and thus impossible to find on the Internet, but not very long ago, I found it used in a bar’s facade, which led me to think that it was a pre-existing font.

The font was white with a black outline, but the TV version had some kind of “reflections”. You’ll understand better if you look at the image. However, the version I saw in the bar (which I assume is the original font) didn’t have them.
